issues.description: The Stock.getStockIngredients() getter has different return types in the template and the solution. In the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) the method returns java.util.List<StockIngredient>, while in the solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) it returns StockIngredient[]. The problem statement instructs students to "add getters for all the private fields" (implying a direct getter for the StockIngredient[] field), but does not specify which return type to use. This inconsistency may confuse students about the expected API and which signature to implement for the getter.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one consistent return type for the Stock.getStockIngredients() getter across template, solution, and instructions. Preferably return the actual field type (StockIngredient[]) to match the private field and the instruction to add getters for private fields: change the template getter to 'public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients()' (and document this in the problem statement). Alternatively, adjust the solution and problem statement to require a List<StockIngredient> getter and update the Stock field access accordingly.
